title.narrative: Leadership for Sustainable Development in Georgia Phase II
Ledarskap för hållbar utveckling i Georgien Phase II

description.narrative: Det övergripande målet för projektet Leadership for Sustainable Development Phase II är att påskynda och skala upp företagens lokala medverkan och engagemang för att uppnå de globala målen för hållbar utveckling genom att stärka ansvarsutkrävande och skapa en bättre miljö för konstruktivt samarbete mellan intressenter.

The overall objective of the project Leadership for Sustainable Development Phase II is to accelerate and scale the local impact of business for delivering the SDGs through ambitious targets, increased accountability, enabling environments, and enhanced multi-stakeholder collaboration.

The overall objective of phase II of the LSDG project is to accelerate and scale the local impact of business for delivering the SDGs through ambitious targets, increased accountability, enabling environments, and enhanced multi-stakeholder collaboration.
Specific Objective 1: To provide a clear framework and encourage ambitious commitments to corporate sustainability and responsible business practices aligned with the corporate sustainability standards and the SDGs in Georgia.
Specific Objective 2: To support the enhancement of public policy in the field of corporate sustainability and its further implementation in Georgia, through advocacy, dialogue, and collective action around a shared agenda.
Specific Objective 3: To ensure organizational development and sustainability of the UN Global Compact Network Georgia, enabling the organization to effectively promote corporate sustainability and business involvement in the implementation of Agenda 2030 in Georgia.

Strategic Objective 4.1: Improved Opportunities for Productive Employment and Decent Work
Business and Human Rights
- Contributed to Georgias National Strategy for Human Rights Protection (2022-2030) and the 2024-2026 Action Plan, integrating key observations on business and human rights. - Developed an ESG Guidebook (draft) and launched the SPARK Accelerator Program for SMEs. Organized awareness sessions with 24 state-owned enterprises (SOEs), introducing two business and human rights guidelines.
Decent Work Action Platform
- Hosted two meetings on workplace discrimination and achieving a living wage, directly benefiting 47 participants from 37 companies and indirectly impacting 21,440 employees.
Forward Faster Initiative on Living Wage
- Promoted corporate commitments to accelerate progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through impactful strategies.
Business and Human Rights Accelerator
- Conducted seven sessions for 14 companies, helping six companies develop robust action plans with one-on-one mentoring. - Organized a regional peer learning session on responsible business practices, showcasing achievements in human rights initiatives.
Awareness and Media Initiatives
- Engaged with national TV and created media content (e.g., infographics and articles) to promote responsible business practices and human rights.
- Held 10 sessions for 14 companies, focusing on gender equality and leadership opportunities.
Sustainable Finance Programs
- Sustainable Finance Action Platform: Developed a comprehensive 12-month program in partnership with the National Bank of Georgia, integrating ESG principles into the financial sector. - Hosted two meetings with 44 participants and provided tools like the Sustainable Finance/ESG Glossary and translated NBG ESG Guidelines into Georgian.
Conferences and Events
- Organized a roundtable discussion on sustainable finance in Batumi with 38 participants and the Partnership4SDGs Forum, which had 70 attendees, focusing on integrating ESG principles and advancing sustainable practices. Corporate Sustainability Award 2024
- Introduced a new category for Sustainable Finance, recognizing businesses advancing sustainability in Georgia.
Strategic Objective 4.3: Strengthened Conditions for Free, Fair, and Sustainable Trade Export Manager Courses
- Delivered two courses in Tbilisi and Batumi, certifying 40 export managers, enhancing knowledge of corporate sustainability standards and export potential. EU Integration Action Platform
- Hosted two workshops with 50 participants and a 10-hour course on EU regulations and corporate sustainability, engaging 20 organizations.
Business Integrity Platform
- Conducted two meetings on anti-corruption practices with 30 participants, promoting collective action against corruption and strengthening compliance standards.

Summary of Results from UN Global Compact Network Georgia's Participation at COP29
UN Global Compact Network Georgia (UNGCNG) actively participated in COP29 (November 1316, 2024) in Baku, marking a milestone by enabling 12 representatives from seven Georgian companies to attend with Blue Zone badges. UNGCNG organized high-impact sessions, including panels on sustainable finance, renewable energy, and supply chain integrity, in collaboration with regional and global networks from countries such as Türkiye, Ukraine, Azerbaijan, and Sweden. These sessions featured prominent Georgian speakers, showcasing their leadership in sustainability initiatives and advancing key topics like ESG integration, decarbonization, and innovative financing solutions. Notable contributions included the Sustainable Finance: Eastern European Perspective panel, which emphasized the role of ESG standards and green finance, and the Energy for the Future session, which explored renewable energy milestones in Europe.
The participation strengthened regional and international partnerships, aligning Georgian companies with global sustainability goals. Five Georgian speakers represented organizations such as the Bank of Georgia, MBC, and GREDA, highlighting their commitment to innovation and green transitions. Outcomes included enhanced collaboration among country networks, recognition of Georgian companies as sustainability leaders, and capacity building for Georgian organizations to tackle global sustainability challenges. These efforts positioned Georgia as an active player in advancing sustainable development both regionally and globally.
